items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: he comes to look me up in Chicago... I introduced him around.

ctx.x: I'm sleeping one morning, who comes in there knocking on the door with Santa? Come on.
Santo Snark and all Johnny's. Yeah.

Yeah, he comes to look me up in Chicago. You know, he was in Beloxi with Joe Pooker. He had a big humbug with his wife and everything. He's like. He's like. So I was working in the town. So I went to work that night. He came with me and everything. You know, I introduced him around. So he had a good trombone player with me and everything.
